text:
maddie_marketing: Hey team — proposing a small PLG pilot for the upcoming workshop launch. Goal: boost activation (first successful prompt completion) and smooth on-ramp. Plan below, would love quick takes by EOD. :rocket: 

maddie_marketing: TL;DR
- 2k free credits reserved for workshop signups
- Prompt-template pack (4 templates: summarizer, rewrite, ideation, code-assist) delivered at signup
- 3 onboarding nudges across 7 days (email, in-console toast, in-app prompt challenge)
- Split test: control (no credits) vs credits-only vs credits+templates+nudges

leo_growth: sounds promising. q: how do we route inbound signups into the experiment vs general funnel? any qualification rules?

maddie_marketing: good call — routing: tag workshop signups with cohort=workshop-pilot and auto-enroll. stop criteria: first 3k signups or 30 days. no manual qualification.

anya_product: metric suite? what's primary metric and pass/fail?

maddie_marketing: primary = % of cohort that completes a prompt template successfully within 7 days (event: prompt.execute with template_id). secondary = 7-day retention (any API call), time-to-first-successful-prompt, avg tokens per successful run. target: +6pp uplift vs control on prompt success.

nina_analytics: can track. need event hooks + experiment_id on all downstream events. will build dashboard.

sam_design: UX note for the template pack — show a first-login modal highlighting 3 top templates with one-click "Try template". keep it minimal, mobile-friendly. i'll drop mocks by tomorrow. :art: 

leo_growth: allocation? if baseline ~18% to detect +6pp we need decent power. 33/33/33 or increase sample.

nina_analytics: quick calc: with baseline 18%, +6pp, 80% power => ~1700 per arm. if capped at 3k total we should bias toward the treatment arms. propose 25% control / 37.5% credits-only / 37.5% full.

maddie_marketing: ok — will push budget to cover 3k users if finance ok. dynamic cap: up to first 3k or 30 days.

anya_product: follow-up sequencing: if a workshop signup doesn't use templates within 48h, queue a soft demo invite + invite to a micro-webinar. keep outreach lightweight.

sam_design: copy snippets for modal + emails: short friendly lines + one micro example per template. will add to doc.

maddie_marketing: draft doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/experiment-spark-pilot (WIP)

leo_growth: consent: add an opt-in checkbox in the modal "Share anonymized prompt usage to help improve templates". important to be explicit.

nina_analytics: privacy ok with opt-in; tag anonymized_use=true/false. also add experiment_id to all analytics events.

eng_ops_bot: experiment created: exp.spark_workshop.4990012345 | cohorts: control/credits/full | allocation: 25/37.5/37.5 | tracking tag: experiment_id=exp.spark_workshop.4990012345

maddie_marketing: great, action items:
- maddie_marketing: confirm budget and update doc (today)
- sam_design: modal + email copy + 1-screen mock (tomorrow noon)
- anya_product: implement follow-up rules for 48h non-use (ETA Wed)
- nina_analytics: dashboard + SQL cohorts + power calc (ETA Wed)
- leo_growth: prep manual outreach list for top 200 signups

leo_growth: will prepare outreach cadence and quick 1-liner.

nina_analytics: will post dashboard link once events are flowing.

maddie_marketing: thanks team. unless any objections i'll flip the switch tomorrow morning. ping me if blocked. :seedling:
